name: Plesk

documentation.title: Configuring DNS via Domain Connect (customer guide)

onboarding.notes: The extension ships a bundled set of templates, built from Plesk's fork of the Templates repository (plesk/domain-connect-templates); new templates reach servers with an extension release.

notes: Stack entry: every Plesk server with the Domain Connect extension in DNS provider mode answers with providerId "plesk.com" and providerName "Plesk" by default (both are configurable). Supported record types: A, AAAA, CNAME, NS, MX, TXT, SRV, SPFM. The signature is checked only when the template sets syncPubKeyDomain; redirect_uri is honoured when the request is signed or its host equals syncRedirectDomain. The extension can also act as a service provider for Plesk-hosted sites.
